preventedFailure: A fork, stale SHA, failed Quality result or pull_request_target candidate execution reaches deployment credentials.
recovery: Repair the exact candidate/default-branch binding and issue a new attempt.
retirementCondition: A stronger accepted workflow identity policy replaces exact-SHA and trusted-source enforcement.
reviewTrigger: Workflow trigger, checkout, candidate, Quality or principal change.
signal: A docs deployment workflow candidate is selected.

preventedFailure: A cancellable or weakly keyed mutation bypasses equal replan, protected approval or provider/state readback.
recovery: Restore the non-cancellable stage lock and equal canonical plan contract.
retirementCondition: A stronger provider-aware distributed lock replaces the repository orchestration lock.
reviewTrigger: Concurrency, plan, approval, Alchemy state or provider readback change.
signal: A Preview, Production or teardown mutation is requested.

preventedFailure: PR-close teardown executes unreviewed pull-request code or destroys a stage other than exact pr-N.
recovery: Stop, retain the receipt and return to reviewed default-branch code plus manual exact-stage recovery.
retirementCondition: A stronger accepted Preview lifecycle owner preserves default-branch and exact-stage proof.
reviewTrigger: PR-close trigger, checkout, stage derivation, destroy or absence-readback change.

preventedFailure: A partial or stale orphan report gains provider mutation or automatic deletion authority.
recovery: Retain the report as inconclusive and require separate exact teardown authority.
retirementCondition: A separately accepted lifecycle owner replaces report-only classification without weakening non-mutation.
reviewTrigger: Inventory source, schedule, credential, classification, teardown or retirement change.
signal: Scheduled or manual orphan inventory runs.
